en: The black-and-white image depicts a European street scene in front of what appears to be an old baroque church or monastery with a distinctive dome and cross. The street is broad and mostly empty except for a few pedestrians. On the right side stands a large monument or fountain surrounded by a small fence, with a plaque visible on the stone. In the background, there are multi-story buildings with traditional steep-roof architecture, and one of them has signage suggesting it is a business establishment.
